Quand personne n'attend, le forgeron fab: When no one is waiting, the blacksmith makes weapons in advance, 5 pieces of each at most. He takes the REAL materials of the game's recipe from the camp stores (iron, steel, guard, pommel, leather, rivets) and 2 charcoals, and pays their sellers for them, with no overdraft; if any is missing, he does not start and an errand is ordered (the courier). His assistant takes the small repairs. A mercenary who has saved up the price, plus 30 groschen to eat, comes to buy the weapon of the rank above his own: cash down, no credit. He keeps it as long as he lives.
